Bring true multitasking back to iOS 17.

PullOver Pro lets you quickly summon your favorite apps from the edge of the screen and use them in a floating window — without leaving your current app.

### Features

- Floating App Multitasking
- QuickSwitch
- Favorites
- Haptic Feedback
- Auto-Minimize Handle
- Japanese & English Preferences
- RootHide Support
